title: Mixed Event — Scramble Fan Festival! — Episode1 A Fan Festival!

meta.Event Outline: Minori, Ichika, Kohane and Nene are all set to sing in the annual VIRTUAL SINGER Fan Festival. Kanade and the rest of N25 also attend, keen to witness their favorite creators. The curtains rise, uniting heartfelt emotions into a grand symphony!

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you again for watching, everyone!
Sadly, our next segment will conclude this stream.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<No, it's over already?>
<Another fun stream.>
<What's next?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Next, MMJ will be...
Replying to your comments!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We want to reply to as many of your comments as we can, and answer some questions that we couldn't get to during our other segments!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: In this segment, we'll look back through some of our old videos and pick out some comments along the way.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Awesome!>
<Best segment ever!>
<I hope they see my comments...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I believe we left quite a few comments on the table during our visit to that elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Unfortunately, we didn't have much time to look through them since we were too busy playing with the students.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
<Airi's show was so good!>
<Airi Momoi's the best!>
There's quite a few of these. Thank you, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you all like it so much!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Happy Everyday = Airi Momoi = Awesome!>
<I wanna see Airi do another solo show!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I couldn't agree more!
Airi's performance put a really big smile on my face too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Can you do another show for us, Airi? Just one more time, pretty please?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, don't drift over to their side.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But...!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Minori gets it.>
<Can't help but love Airi.>
<Fan first, idol second lol.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. They seem to be on your side now, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You guys liked it that much? I don't know what to say. I couldn't be happier as an idol.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks, all of you!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Phew.
Great stream today, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, that was so much fun♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I didn't realize that your performance went over this well with everyone that time, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shizuku's right. It's like that stream is why we've been seeing an influx of comments for our other videos.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They must've all been so moved by your performance.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Stop, you're making me blush...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But it's true, Airi! You were so amazing that time!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I hope I get a chance to do that on stage someday...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure you will, Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks, Haruka...!
I'll keep trying my best to make that a reality!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, all together now!
Raise your hands in the air...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Even if I do get that chance, will I really be able to sing and dance as well as Airi did that day...?)
The next day

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Minori?
Is something bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, sorry!
I didn't mean to space out like that. Even after I promised to have lunch with you two today...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It's okay, Minori.
I mean, all we did was trade some side dishes.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Uh... Well, it's about how I haven't really been able to catch up to the other idols in my group...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, they all have so much experience performing on stage and giving their fans hope, but I'm still pretty much stuck at square one...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've been doing better during streams, like during talk portions, but when it comes to actually performing on stage, I still have to rely on them a lot.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: My singing and dancing pales in comparison to their skills, so I want to catch up as fast as I can...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I know exactly how you feel...
I'm also the only one on my team with no prior musical experience.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I practiced as much as I possibly could to make sure I didn't hold my teammates back.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I didn't know...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm with her, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We just performed in our very first show as a band, but it didn't go nearly as well as I expected it to...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I understand your desire to get better and improve.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Kohane, Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, I'm not alone...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, you're not.
I have a feeling that we all have some experience with that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So if you'd like, we can try working through it together.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: By the way, how do you two practice what you need to work on usually?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Until just recently, I practiced singing at live houses and by doing street performances all on my own.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What?! All on your own?!
Weren't you nervous...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
At first, yes.
But I had the least amount of experience compared to my other teammates.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's why I decided to practice that way. In order to catch up to them as quickly as possible.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I had no idea... What about you, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I did street performances on my own too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: At first, my goal was to catch up to Shiho and learn to sing better...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I ended up learning that there's so much more to gain from performing in front of others and how you can only make certain realizations by doing just that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I see... You're both so incredible.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've been relying on Haruka and the others so much, so maybe I should start practicing on my own too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But how? Where? Should I start doing street performances like you two...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Where...? I'm not sure.
It might be good to find a place that closely resembles where you'll actually be performing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, somewhere with a stage?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Like a live house?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But the places I usually go aren't really for idols per se...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, same with my usual spot...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Where would be a good place?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Somewhere with a stage that's idol-friendly, and room for people to come and watch...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I know...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What about a VIRTUAL SINGER Fan Festival?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A VIRTUAL SINGER Fan Festival?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, here... Like one of those VIRTUAL SINGER fan appreciation events that take place around this time of year.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They're fairly big events too, so anyone can participate as long as they're even remotely involved with VIRTUAL SINGER music.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...
They're all creators, producers, dancers and other similar artists.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Exactly. They're even looking for amateur singers, so this might be the perfect opportunity for you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That sounds like fun!
Especially since I love Miku so much. This really does sound like the perfect event.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think I'd like to as well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Kohane, you too?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm singing with my team right now because of VIRTUAL SINGER songs too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, what if we all went to one of these Fan Festivals together?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Together...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. I've actually been watching this particular one every year.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Being a Miku fan is what led me to this event, but I'm always amazed by how these artists shine as they sing VIRTUAL SINGER songs on that stage.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: For so long, I just watched everything happen. But now, I think I have what it takes to go on that stage and sing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
S-So...
If you're both okay with it, I'd like it if we all went together.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, let's do it!
I wanna join you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: M-Me too...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: R-Really?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes, really...!
I understand how you feel, Ichika. Now feels like the right moment.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So I want to join you too...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks, you two.
I'll send in our application... Oh, we might want to discuss this with our groups first.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
I'll try asking my team later.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I can't wait to participate in this event together! It's gonna be so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(A VIRTUAL SINGER Fan Festival...!
Miku's helped me out so much already, so it'd be great to participate in an event like this...)
